summary: Columbia County lookout on Meissner Point: a 40-foot timber tower with an ODF cab, built 1952-53, abandoned in the early 1970s and removed afterward.

facts.design: 40-foot timber tower with a 14x14 cab; the register describes an ODF cab
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1971, 1973 or the early 1970s depending on source; removed sometime afterward, with no removal year given

staffing.status: manned on a 24-hour basis from June 16, 1967; no end-of-staffing date in these sources

events.note: Register and firelookout.com give 1953; Rex's notes give 1952 for construction
Window replaced; lookout painted inside and out
Manned on a 24-hour basis from June 16, 1967; the same item says the fire index had moved into the medium range
Rex's notes say 1971; the register says 1973; firelookout.com says the early 1970s

evidence.supports: built 1953 as a 40-foot timber tower with ODF cab; abandoned 1973; removed afterward
evidence.quote: Built in 1953, this 40' timber tower with ODF cab was abandoned in 1973, and removed sometime afterward.

evidence.supports: firelookout.com gives 1953 build and early-1970s abandonment
evidence.quote: Built in 1953, this 40' timber tower with ODF cab was abandoned in the early 1970's, and removed sometime afterward.

evidence.supports: 1952 construction of a 40-foot treated timber tower with 14x14 cab
evidence.quote: 1952: A 40-foot treated timber tower with a 14x14 cab was constructed at a total cost of $3637.47.

evidence.supports: 1953 window replaced and lookout painted inside and out
evidence.quote: 1953: The lookout had a window replaced, a new garbage pit dug and was painted inside and out.

evidence.supports: Oregon Department of Forestry fire warden and fire index moved to medium range in 1967
evidence.quote: the fire warden of Oregon Department of Forestry reports the index there has been moved into the 'medium' range.
Their Meissner Lookout tower will be manned on a 24-hour a day basis beginning today.

evidence.supports: site is a named locale in Columbia County; no structure listed
evidence.quote: Meissner Lookout is a locale located in Columbia County, OR

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and firelookout.com give 1953; Rex's notes give 1952 for the tower's construction and 1953 for a window replacement. The story uses 1953 and mentions 1952.
Rex's notes say 1971, the register says 1973, and firelookout.com says the early 1970s. The story reports all three.

notes_for_editor: Brief elevation_m 460.9 (about 1,512 ft) disagrees with TopoQuest's 1368 ft MSL (about 417 m); the source of the brief value was not checked, so the brief is unchanged. No source describes access, the site today, or an end-of-staffing date. Rex's notes also quote a 1952 agency newsletter calling the planned tower a standard Forest Service type CT3 with laminated legs, which differs from the treated timber in the cost entry; not used in the story.
